quest.title: Lies and Promises
quest.description: You discover a Yumkasaurus standing in the way of some treasure. Can you find a way to make it leave...?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! There's treasure in the cave, but this fella here has totally blocked off the entrance, and won't move at all...

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: Arrooo?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah? What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: Arrooo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Bah, Paimon didn't understand that at all! {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, can you tell what this Yumkasaur is trying to say?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Ehrrr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like that didn't work... *sigh* And even if they could understand each other, it's not like we could talk with {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If only we had a way to understand what was being said, then maybe we could give it what it wants and make it move out of the way.

talks.objective: Find a way to communicate with the Yumkasaurus

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What were you mumbling about just now?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: *grumble*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, could it be you're really hungry?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A Saurian here all by itself, and no master in sight... It probably isn't even able to find its own food...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's go help find it some food!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Once it gets full and moves out of the way, the treasure will be all ours! Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What should we feed it, though?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon think for a sec! Saurians here tend to eat a bit of everything, and Paimon isn't sure what Yumkasaurs eat... Looking at its color, it feels kinda like it should eat leaves and grass and that kinda thing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's find one of those and give it a try first! Hungry bellies tend not to be too picky!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Hehe, sure looks good. It'll definitely like it!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Yumkasaur downs the food in front of it in a flash.\nYou almost don't even manage to see just how the feat was accomplished...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: L—Look at the food... It's vanishing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what're you trying to say? Paimon's a true gourmet, she's very particular about food, and would never just chow down like that... How can you truly enjoy your food if you just vacuum it up?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, maybe the poor thing was just starving! Poor fella, let's give it another serving.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Arawrrr...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Does {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} also want to eat? Let's feed this other Sauropal first, and then we'll fix you up something delicious!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The hungry Saurian eats everything you lay out in a single gulp.\nYou blink, as though the scene seemed to unfold twice...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, that should at least fill your tummy—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Wait a sec, how are you sitting down again? Is two servings not enough!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, and just going to sleep right in front of the cave after eating? Doesn't seem remotely interested in getting out of the way, either!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What should we do, {NICKNAME}? Paimon doesn't get this guy... Even if you wanna take a nap after eating, at least don't block the way!

choices.text: I don't think it ever agreed to get out of the way, though.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grraaaah! And it ate so much of our food too...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Even {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} can't stand to watch! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, we've gotta try and wake it up!

choices.text: Definitely feels like we've been had.
Just one serving... doesn't seem to be enough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Y—Yeah! Paimon couldn't tell, but this little guy's a real "Megasnackasaurus"... It's a good thing {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} can't eat that much...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehh, it won't wake up? Ugh, so annoying! D'you think it's just pretending to be asleep?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Ehrrr?

choices.text: It does seem to actually be asleep...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (You relate the contents of the sleep-talk...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you saying it's intentionally blocking the way just to get food, cheating people out of their grub... Ugh. We fell for it hook, line, and sinker...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! But if that's how things are, then we don't have to play nice!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Let's just have {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} tunnel over and get to that chest!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If it's gonna take the low road, we can't be expected to play fair either!

talks.objective: Get your Saurian companion to take away the treasure chest

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, well done! Now let's see what goodies are hiding in the chest!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah? There's nothing at all? Just a note?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so the one who left the note was its actual master? So we weren't tricked by the Saurian, but by its master?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Even if he was really sick, how could he just leave his Yumkasaur in a place like this!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And he even wanted to use people's greed to... No, wait, he wanted to take advantage of people's empathy for the Saurian...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Anyway, it's not like we can just let it stay here tricking people out of their food. Let's go find the Chief of the Scions of the Canopy and tell him about this.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain the situation to Wayna, chief of the Scions of the Canopy, and bring him over.

response.speaker: Wayna
response.text: Oh dear, I had a hunch about this when you came looking for me...

response.speaker: Wayna
response.text: Who'd have thought it was that scoundrel that left behind this creature...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That scoundrel?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrawr?

response.speaker: Wayna
response.text: He was one who did wrong, then in fear of punishment, left the tribe of his own accord.

response.speaker: Wayna
response.text: But I see no good in divulging the offender's name. Perhaps he himself was well aware that what he did was no good thing. See — he didn't even leave his name at the end of this letter.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So his Saurian chose to join him...

response.speaker: Wayna
response.text: No, we cannot say that it "chose" to do so. Saurians are simple creatures that cannot easily distinguish right from wrong. Most of the time, they simply follow their emotions and trust their companions.

response.speaker: Wayna
response.text: ...As I suspected, at the core, he hasn't changed. Whatever small wits he has he employs towards devising tricks to deceive others, even his own Saurian.

response.speaker: Wayna
response.text: We will send people to feed this Yumkasaurus on a regular basis. It is a child of the tribe, after all...

response.speaker: Wayna
response.text: As for that scoundrel... *sigh* It is a tragic ending indeed, but I refuse to sympathize with him. People should be held responsible for their actions.

choices.text: So, those who eat too much are destined to be abandoned by their friends...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Don't even joke about things like that! Besides, the Saurian is innocent in all this, maybe it's just waiting here for its master to return, which is why it refuses to move...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Do you not like it...? It won't touch it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey now, beggars aren't supposed to be this choosy... Hmm, just what kind of food might it like?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: Arrooo?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, is there something you want? ...If only we had a way to know what that is...

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: Arroo arroo... *stomach rumbling*

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: *snoring* *snoring*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this Saurian's sleeping unreasonably soundly... Guess it's a layabout on top of being a greedy-guts.

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: Remember now... *gurgle* Want to eat... Meaty food...

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: Want to eat...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: Flat stomach, stomach, so hot...

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: Want to eat—

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: *snoring*... He's right. Just need block cave... *snoring*... Then can eat meaty food...

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: (The Yumkasaur falls into a deep sleep. It doesn't seem like you'll be able to wake it up.)

dialogues.speaker: Strange Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: *snoring* *snoring*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this Saurian's sleeping unreasonably soundly... Guess it's a layabout on top of being a greedy-guts.
